name: FaceTune / AI eye whitening

lead: Photo apps such as FaceTune offer tools to whiten the eyes and brighten the iris in pictures.
These edits change the photograph only, and no research on them was found.

paras: Software selects the eye region and increases brightness or saturation, sometimes using AI segmentation.
No physical risks; critics of heavy retouching in general raise concerns about unrealistic image standards, though no study specific to eye whitening was found.

lead: FaceTune and similar photo-editing apps include tools that brighten or whiten the sclera and iris in photographs. Some appearance communities discuss using such edits to make eyes look brighter.

paras: This is digital retouching of images rather than a change to the person. No published research on its effects was identified in the sources consulted.
